decisions.reason: Conceptual readiness checklist: no one screen can prove all signals, consent, channels and handoffs. Do not substitute synthetic receipts or unrelated reports.
Native All and In my plan filters. Existing singleton reuse remains explained from controller; no fabricated singleton fixture or entitlement proof.

Custom Agent native cards include Incoming channels on desktop; lists identify type-specific alternatives. Provider account/sender/template setup belongs to linked channel guides; no outgoing-readiness or delivery result is claimed.

Launch checklist names what to review, rather than instructing how to construct every route or configure each component. Custom Agent cards locate its controls. Graph construction, trigger/Wait/Condition/Assignment tutorials remain separate consuming-article debts, not required demonstrations of this generic launch switch.
Native empty supported Playground, complete composer and mobile tab; no fake response, model generation, admission or Inbox outcome.

New unsaved OFF header, existing synthetic ON header, saved Active label, actual Disable menu and original Inactive label are distinct controls/states. Contained temporary fixture preparation and restoration explicitly disclosed. No button submission or external effect.
Operational checklist points to each reader’s own messages, conversations and report. Demo state has no delivered result; a fabricated receipt or unrelated campaign KPI would mislead.
Conceptual one-change-at-a-time advice; existing status figures explain saved state, repeated configuration screenshots add no new control.
Navigation only; all original ordered links preserved.
